title: 日本ダービーにむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the day of the Japanese Derby, after numerous ideal sessions of training, Mejiro Bright heads off to the track in high spirits.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At the same time, however, Silence Suzuka flounders, unsure of how she should run in the race that's about to start.
